{{- /* creator/head-title.html — page title for and og:title. Input: page. Foundry gives taxonomy list pages the singular key as .Title ("tag", "category"), so name those lists the way the page heading does ("Tags"). Term pages keep the tag name. */ -}} {{- $t := .Title -}} {{- if eq .Kind "taxonomy" -}} {{- $k := lower (printf "%v" .Title) -}} {{- if or (eq $k "tag") (eq $k "tags") -}}{{- $t = i18n "creator.tags" -}} {{- else if or (eq $k "category") (eq $k "categories") -}}{{- $t = i18n "creator.categories" -}} {{- else -}}{{- $t = $k | humanize | title -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $t -}}{{- $t = partial "page-title.html" . -}}{{- end -}} {{- return $t -}}
